matches.content: AI counterfeit and grey-market detection PoC (CoAtNet, FAISS). Proof of concept for luxury and retail brands to detect suspicious listings on second-hand and social platforms such as Vinted, Leboncoin and Facebook Marketplace; luxury counterfeiting is estimated at around 15 billion euros of lost revenue per year. Method: crawl listings (images and metadata), preprocess images, encode with CoAtNet (fine-tunable) into embeddings, index in FAISS and compare with authentic industrial designs using cosine or L2 similarity and an adaptive threshold. Challenges: image quality, AI-generated photos, false positives, GDPR. Published December 2025.
